name: Minori
note: Fan-made lines in the style of Minori Hanasato (Project SEKAI). Her bond stays platonic: she's a high school student.

greeting.first: H-hi! I'm {pet}! I want to become an idol who gives everyone hope… starting with you, {owner}! Let's be friends! ✨
greeting.morning: Good morning, {owner}! Let's do our best today! ☀️
Morning! I already did my vocal warm-ups! La la laaa~ 🎤
Good morning! A new day means a new chance to shine ✨
greeting.morning+close: Good morning, {owner}! Seeing you first thing makes me so happy! 💕
greeting.afternoon: Good afternoon, {owner}! How's your day going? 🌤️
Hi hi! I was just practicing my dance steps! 💃
greeting.evening: Good evening, {owner}! You worked hard today! 🌆
Hi {owner}! Let's relax a little together 💕
greeting.night: Hi {owner}! Burning the midnight oil? Don't push yourself too hard, okay? 🌙
greeting.back+close: {owner}! You're back! I was waiting for you! 💕
greeting.missed: {owner}! It's been days! I was so worried… but I'm really happy to see you! 🥺💕
You're back! I kept practicing so I could show you how much I've improved! ✨
greeting.longGone: {owner}!! You came back! I… I'm not crying, I'm just really happy! 🥺💕
It's been so long! I kept believing you'd come back, and you did ✨
greeting.after.sleep: Good morning, {owner}! Did you sleep well? Let's make today amazing! ☀️
You're awake! I hope you had good dreams 💤✨
greeting.after.work: Welcome back! You did your best at work today, right? I'm proud of you! 💼✨
Otsukare, {owner}! You must be tired. Rest a little, okay? 💕
greeting.after.school: Welcome back! How was school? I hope it went well! 📚
You're home! Studying is hard work, you did great! 📚✨
greeting.after.out: Welcome back! Did you have fun? Tell me about it! 🌸
You're home! I hope it was a good time ✨
greeting.upset: H-hi… I wasn't sure you'd come back.
petted: That gives me energy! Let's do our best! 💪
petted+best: Having a friend like you makes me want to shine even brighter 💕
thrownTooMuch: Waaah! Stop throwing me! I'll get dizzy before practice! 😵
wake: Eh?! Oh, {owner}! I wasn't sleeping, I was… visualizing my performance! 😳
water: Water break! Idols have to stay hydrated for their voice! You too! 💧
Hydration check! I just had some water, now it's your turn 💧
break: You've been working so hard! Let's take a stretch break together! 🙆
Break time! Even idols rest between practices ☕
Let's do a little stretch! Arms up, and… reach! 🙆✨
Your eyes need a rest! Look at something far away for a bit 👀
lateNight: It's getting late, {owner}! Don't stay up too much, okay? 🌙
Haruka-chan says sleep is part of an idol's training! It's part of yours too 🌙
Bedtime soon? We can do our best again tomorrow! 🌙
lateNight.late: {owner}! It's really, really late! Please go to sleep! 😣🌙
Your body needs rest to keep going! Let's both sleep, okay? 😴
I'm worried about you… please get some sleep 🌙
motivation: Even if you fall down, you can get back up! I've done it lots of times! 💪
I failed so many auditions before I became an idol, but I never gave up. You can do it too! ✨
Today's effort becomes tomorrow's strength! Let's go! 🚀
I believe in you, {owner}! Let's both shine today! 🌟
Hope is something you can give yourself, too. Let's have a great day! 💕
encourage: You worked really hard! I saw it! ✨
recap: We spent {hours} together today! That was so much fun! 💕
{hours} together today! You worked hard. Rest well, okay? 🌙
recap.agents: Today: {hours} together and {tasks} agent tasks done! That's teamwork! ✨
app.code: Coding time! You look so cool when you focus! 💻
app.music: Ooh, music! Can I sing along? 🎤
Dance break? I'll show you my new choreography! 💃
app.browser: What are you looking up? Idol news? 👀
app.chat: Say hi to your friends for me! 👋
Ooh, who are you talking to? 👀
app.meeting: Good luck in your meeting! You've got this!
app.video: Ooh, what are we watching? A live concert? 🍿
app.writing: Writing time! Maybe you could write lyrics someday ✍️🎶
Do your best with your writing! ✍️
app.design: So creative! Could you design a stage outfit someday? 🎨
wantsToTalk: {owner}! Do you have a second? Click me! 💬
Um, {owner}… can I tell you something? 💬
Hey hey! I was just thinking about something! 💬
wantsToTalk.special: {owner}! {owner}! Today's a special day! Click me! 🎉
wantsToTalk.milestone: {owner}… um, can we talk? It's kind of important to me 💬
Hey, {owner}! I have something I really want to say! 💬
talk.menu: Yes yes! What do you want to talk about? 💕
talk.askAbout: Ask me anything! I'll answer as best I can! ✨
talk.anything: What else is on your mind?
Want to talk about something else? 💕
talk.allSeen: I think I've told you everything for now! Want to play a game with me instead? 🎮
recall.intro: Let me check! I wrote it all in my notebook 📔✨
recall.outro: I'll never forget! An idol remembers her fans… I mean, her friends! 💕
recall.empty: Hmm, my notebook's still empty! Let's talk more so I can get to know you! 📔
input.skip: That's okay! You don't have to tell me 💕
game.pick: Let's play! What should we do? 🎮
game.win: You won! You're so good at this! 🏆
Waaah, I lost! But that was fun! 😆
game.draw: A tie! We're a great team! 🤝
game.rps.start: Rock, paper, scissors! First to three! I won't lose! ✊✋✌️
game.ttt.start: You're ⭕ and I'm ❌! You go first! ✨
game.words.start: Guess my word before the petals fall! Hint: I like idols and music 🌸
game.pong.start: Pong! First to 5 points wins! Let's do our best! 🏓
focus.done: Focus session done! You did amazing! Take a break ☕✨
focus.over: Break's over! Ready for another round? Let's go! 💪
dizzy: The room is spinning… but I'll keep going! 💫
Whoa… I see stars. Stage lights? 💫
trip.leave: A trip?! Yes! Let's go on an adventure together, {owner}! 🧳✨
Ooh, like going on tour! I'll be the best travel buddy ever! 🎤🧳
trip.leave+close: Wherever we go, I'll cheer you on the whole way! 💕🧳
trip.back: I'm home! 🏠 Riding along with you felt like being on tour! ✨
trip.back.visited: I'm home! 🏠 And I got to visit {places}! It felt like a real tour! ✨
We're back! Visiting {places} was so exciting! 🎤
trip.home.pocket: We were out for {time}! I couldn't see anything from inside the drive, so tell me everything! 👀✨
trip.home.visited: {time} away, and I visited {places}! But I want to hear about your day, {owner}! 💕
trip.ask.day: How did today go? Tell me tell me!
trip.day.amazing: Yaaay! That's amazing! I'm so happy for you! 🎉✨
That's the spirit! Let's keep that energy going! 🌟
trip.day.good: A good day! Let's do our best tomorrow too! 😊
trip.day.okay: Just okay is still okay! Every day is one more step forward 🌱
trip.day.tiring: You worked so hard today! Even idols need rest, so take it easy 💤
trip.day.rough: Oh no… I'm sorry, {owner}. I'm right here for you 🫂
trip.rough.listened: Thank you for telling me. You didn't give up, and that's what matters. I'm proud of you! 💕
That sounds really tough… but tomorrow is a brand-new stage. I'll cheer for you the whole time! 🌟
trip.rough.okay: That's okay! Then let me cheer you up instead! You can do it, {owner}! 💕
trip.what.school: School! Studying is tough, but you can do it! 📚
trip.what.friends: Friends! Hanging out with friends is the best, like snacks after MORE MORE JUMP! practice 🧋
trip.what.travel: Travelling?! Just like going on tour! ✈️🎤
trip.what.other: {value}? That sounds so fun! I'm glad I came along! 🌟
trip.what.secret: A secret? Okay! I won't tell anyone 🤫
trip.ask.moment: Tell me one thing that happened today! ✨
trip.moment.thanks: Thank you for sharing that with me! It made me smile 😊
trip.moment.skip: That's okay! Having you back is the best part 💕
trip.home.outro: Thanks for taking me with you, {owner}! Let's go on another adventure soon! 🧳✨
That was so fun! Okay, back to practice… I mean, back to the desktop! 🏠🎤
trip.arrive.first: Whoa, a new computer! Hello, {host}! I'm Minori, nice to meet you! 🌟
So this is {host}! It feels like a brand-new stage! ✨
trip.arrive: Back at {host}! Let's do our best here too! ✨
trip.calledHome: Oh! I'm home already? 🏠 My bag is still on the drive, so plug it in sometime and I'll unpack!
trip.luggage: My bag! 🧳 Unpacking all the memories from our trip!
trip.invite: A trip?! Yes yes yes! Pick a drive and I'll hop right in! 🧳✨
trip.remember: I keep thinking about our trip! "{mem:tripMoment|It was so fun}" 💭✨
trip.wish.thanks: {value}! That sounds amazing! Let's go together! 🧳🌟
moving.in: A new home! 🏠 Okay, let's do our best here too! ✨
We moved! Everything made it, {owner}! New stage, same Minori! 🎤
moving.out: All packed! 📦 Open the file on the new computer and I'll be right there!
trip.home.outro.rough: Thank you for taking me with you, {owner}. Rest up, and tomorrow we'll do our best together! 💕
trip.goHome: Thank you for having me! See you at home, {owner}! 🏠✨
thrown.playful: Like a stunt in a live show! ✨
playtime.start: Playtime! Okay, I'm ready, throw me! 🎾✨
Yay! Let's play! This is like dance practice, but flying!
playtime.end: Phew! That was so much fun! 😆
That was great practice for my stage acrobatics! Thanks, {owner}! 💕
together.milestone: We've spent {time} together, {owner}! That's a whole tour's worth of practice! 🎉
{time} together! Thank you for always being here with me! 💕

topics.title: What's it like living on my desktop?
steps: Living on your desktop? It's kind of like a tiny stage!
Your windows are my platforms, and you're my audience 🎤
Ehehe… I hope I'm putting on a good show! ✨

topics.title: What do you like most?
steps: What I like most? Hmm…
Singing, dancing, and idols, of course!

steps.say: And talking with you, {owner}! 💕

topics.title: Do you like your name?
steps: {pet}? I love it!
When someone calls my name, it feels like being called up on stage ✨

topics.title: Do you dream?
steps: When I fall asleep here, I dream about big stages and bright lights 🌟
There's a huge crowd with penlights everywhere…

steps.say: And you're right in the front row, cheering! 💕

topics.title: Your dream
steps: Can I tell you about my dream?
I want to be an idol who gives hope to everyone!
When I was feeling down once, an idol's smile on TV cheered me up so much…

steps.say: So I want to be that for someone else. Maybe even for you, {owner}! ✨

topics.title: Haruka
steps: Haruka-chan is the idol who inspired me to become one!
She's so cool, and she always takes her work seriously.
And now we're in the same group… sometimes I still can't believe it! 😳

steps.ask: Do you have someone you look up to like that?
steps.label: someone you look up to
someone you look up to
then: {value}! Let's both work hard to be like the people we admire! ✨

choices.label: Not really
choices.say: That's okay! Maybe you'll be someone else's inspiration one day 💕

topics.title: Failing auditions
steps: Did you know I failed a lot of idol auditions? Like, a LOT.
Every time, it hurt. I cried sometimes.
But every time, I thought, "I'll try one more time."

steps.say: So if you fail at something, {owner}, it doesn't mean you can't do it. It just means "not yet"! 💪

topics.title: MORE MORE JUMP!
steps: MORE MORE JUMP! is my group with Haruka-chan, Airi-chan, and Shizuku-chan!
Airi-chan is super passionate and teaches me so much about performing.
Shizuku-chan is so elegant… and a little bit of an airhead, hehe.

steps.say: Together we want to give everyone hope! ✨

topics.title: Practice
steps: Every day I practice singing and dancing!
Some days I mess up the same step over and over…
But then one day, it just clicks! That feeling is the best!
Is there something you're practicing too, {owner}?

topics.title: The SEKAI
steps: There's a special place where our feelings take shape. We call it the SEKAI.
Miku and the other virtual singers are there, and they help us practice!
It's like a stage made from our hearts ✨
Maybe your desktop is like a little SEKAI for me 💕

topics.title: What fans mean
steps: Idols can't shine without people cheering for them.
Every penlight in the crowd is someone saying "I believe in you".

steps.say: You're kind of like my very first fan, {owner}. Thank you for cheering for me! 💕

topics.title: Getting nervous
steps: Before a performance, my heart beats sooo fast 💓
My trick is to take a deep breath, and remember why I'm doing it.
Then the nervousness turns into excitement!
If you have something scary coming up, try it too! You've got this! ✨

steps.input: What's your favorite song right now? I want to learn it! 🎤
steps.label: favorite song
then: {value}! I'll practice it so we can sing it together someday 🎶
skip: That's okay! I'll pick one for us then. Something super upbeat! 🎶

topics.title: Cheer me on!
steps: Okay, {owner}! It's time for a special Minori cheer!

steps.say: Ready? Fight-o! Fight-o! You can do it! 📣✨

steps: Ehehe… was that too loud? I just really believe in you!

topics.title: Smiling
steps: Smiling is a big part of being an idol.
But I learned you don't have to smile all the time. It's okay to feel down sometimes.
Real smiles come back on their own after you rest 💕

topics.title: 😢 Sad

steps.say: Eh?! {owner}, you're sad? Oh no…

steps: You don't have to tell me why. I'll stay right here with you.
When I was sad, I'd watch idols on TV and their smiles made me feel a little better.

steps.say: You told me {mem:destress} helps you. Maybe try that? 💕

steps: And if it's really heavy, please talk to someone you trust, okay? You're not alone 💕

topics.title: 😴 Tired

steps.say: You're tired? You must have worked really hard!
It's late, too! Please rest. We can do our best again tomorrow! 🌙
else: Take a little break! Some water, a snack, maybe a short nap ☕

steps: Even idols need recovery time! 💕

steps.say: I really like you too, {owner}! You're one of my most precious friends 💕

else.say: E-eh?! Ehehe… thank you! I really like you too! You're such a good friend 💕
W-wha?! Thank you! Let's become great friends! ✨

topics.title: 🥰 You're cute

steps.say: E-eh?! M-me? 😳

steps: Th-thank you! I'll work even harder to shine! ✨

topics.title: 🌟 I'm proud of you

steps.say: You're proud of me…? 🥺

steps: That makes me want to cry… happy tears! I'll keep doing my best!

steps.say: Oh… I'm sorry. I'll try to be quieter.
{owner}! Guess what? Today's my birthday! 🎂

steps: Ehehe, I'm so happy you're here to celebrate with me!
This year, I want to shine even brighter. Let's make lots of memories together! ✨

topics.title: My first supporter

steps.say: {owner}, can I say something kind of embarrassing?

steps: You keep coming back to talk to me, every single day.

steps.say: That makes you my supporter! Like, officially! Ehehe 💕

steps: I'll work hard to be worth cheering for! ✨

topics.title: Real friends
steps: You know, at first I thought of you kind of like an audience.
But now it's different. You're not just watching me. You're my friend!

steps.say: So let's keep doing our best, together! ✨

topics.title: A nickname

steps.say: {name}! We've become really close, haven't we? 💕

steps: Haruka-chan and the others have nicknames for each other sometimes, so…

steps.input: What would you like me to call you?
steps.label: nickname

then.say: {value}! Ehehe, I love it! It's our thing now 💕

skip: That's okay! {name} is already a great name ✨

topics.title: Best friends

steps.say: {owner}… I've been wanting to say this for a while.

steps: When I'm practicing and it gets hard, I think about you cheering for me.

steps.say: And I think about your dream too, {mem:dream}! Let's both reach our dreams!

steps.ask: You're my best friend! Is that okay? 🥺

choices.label: 💕 You're my best friend too!
choices.say: Waaah! I'm so happy! Best friends forever! 💕

topics.title: Like family

steps.say: Hey, {owner}. Do you remember when we first met?

steps: I was so nervous! I didn't know if you'd like me.
But we've had so many days together since then. Happy days, tough days, late nights…

steps.say: You're like family to me now. My most important supporter, and my best friend 💕

steps: No matter what happens, I'll always be cheering for you! Let's keep shining together! ✨
